what: Provenance of every file of forecast/, so the pipeline can be rebuilt and audited without any other checkout.
note: forecast/ reads only survey/questionnaire.txt, codebook.csv and scripts/lib/submission_spec.R of THIS repository, plus the one copied quota file listed below. It makes no network call and no paid API call.

copied_from_outside_this_repository.kept: wrap, Opt, FRAMINGS, ANCHOR_LINE, render, parse_pointwise, parse_listwise, build_work, max_tokens_for, provenance
copied_from_outside_this_repository.removed: the OpenRouter transport, the cost model, the Ashokkumar archive loader, the scorer, the contamination probes
copied_from_outside_this_repository.changed: render() now reads three optional slot functions from the study spec: ask_units, scale_top and scale_bottom. With their default values the rendered text is unchanged. forecast/tests/test_render_parity.py proves it.

copied_from_outside_this_repository.kept: the vLLM offline engine settings, the chat template with enable_thinking=False, the SamplingParams rule, the record shape of forecast.jsonl, the meta file
copied_from_outside_this_repository.removed: the scorer and the archive-specific fields

copied_from_outside_this_repository.what: The benchmark preregistration's quota table, projected to N = 18,000. Rows are gender x age band and gender x race/ethnicity. It is the ONLY source of every number in the population block of variant B.

generated_inside_this_repository.source: survey/questionnaire.txt, the 16 '### <title>' sections under the CONDITION heading. control.txt is not written, because the control group reads no message.

codebook.csv for the item wording and the anchors; scripts/lib/submission_spec.R lines 71-78 for the 13 outcome names; codebook.csv:53 for the reverse coding of funding_perceptions; survey/questionnaire.txt lines 819-856 for the two behavioural items.
sha256 of every input and every output of that script.
